meta.description: Report incidents safely in Kraków — anonymously, with human help.

common.simulation: Prototype simulation — no services are contacted.
common.example: Example layout with sample data. Real records appear here in a later phase.
common.comingSoon: Available in a later phase of this prototype.

disclaimer.title: In danger right now? Call 112.
disclaimer.body: Haven is not an emergency service and nobody watches reports in real time. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112.

home.title: Start with what you have
home.lead: Tell us what happened, in your own words. Save a private draft, add photos or video when you can, and decide later whether to file it.
home.noAccountBody: You can report as a guest. Drafts stay private until you choose to file them. You never have to give your name or contact the police.
home.next1: Your report gets a reference number you can keep.
home.next2: It is routed to the kind of human help it needs — a support service, a volunteer network or the police, only if you agree.
home.next3: You can follow updates in My reports.
home.continueEmpty: You started a report but haven’t written anything yet.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in to follow your reports from another device, or to open a staff workspace.
login.guest: You don't need an account to report.
login.errorTooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
login.errorUnavailable: Haven can't be reached right now. Please try again in a moment.
login.demoLead: These accounts are fictional demo fixtures. Their passwords are public — never use them for real data.

reportNew.title: Report an incident
reportNew.lead: Take your time. Everything stays a private draft until you choose to file it.

error.unavailable: We couldn’t start your draft. Please try again in a moment.
error.notAllowed: This account can’t file resident reports.

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.lead: Your private drafts and filed reports, newest first.
myReports.emptyBody: When you start a report, it appears here as a private draft.
myReports.guestNotice: You’re reporting as a guest, so these reports are tied to this browser. Clearing its cookies or switching devices loses access to them.

report.title: Report
report.draftLead: Only you can see this draft. It saves as you type.
report.sampleWhat: A group shouted insults at me at the tram stop because of my accent.
report.filedBody: Your reference is <ref>{reference}</ref>. Keep it if you want to follow up.

area.title: Area reports
area.lead: How many incidents were filed in each Kraków district. Exact locations are never shown.
area.notScore: The public map is not a safety score.
area.privacy: To protect the people who report, a district with fewer than {threshold} filed reports shows no number. Drafts and cancelled reports are never counted.
area.mapLabel: Map of Kraków districts shaded by filed reports
area.unavailable: Area reports are unavailable right now. Please try again later.

settings.title: Account and settings
settings.guest: You are using Haven as a guest.

queue.title: Response queue
queue.lead: Filed reports waiting for an operator decision, most urgent first.
queue.routingBody: Smart Router result and rule appear here.
queue.advisoryBody: A deterministic, rule-based suggestion. It never decides for you.

needs_review.title: Nothing needs review
needs_review.body: Newly filed reports and resident updates appear here.

awaiting_resident.title: No one to wait for
awaiting_resident.body: Cases where you asked the resident for more information appear here.

handled.title: Nothing handled yet
handled.body: Promoted and cancelled cases appear here.

recommendation.request_more_evidence: Suggested: ask the resident for the evidence they mention
recommendation.transfer_to_ngo: Suggested: send to the community volunteer network

queue.noSuggestion: No suggestion is available for this case.

action.operator_promote: {actor} sent the case to an organisation

vault.title: Evidence vault
vault.lead: Photos, video and audio attached to filed reports.
vault.emptyBody: Evidence from filed reports appears here.
vault.custodyBody: Evidence is stored privately and is never public. Open a file only when the case needs it; every viewing is logged.

cases.title: Assigned cases
cases.lead: Cases routed to your organisation. Claim a case, record what you did outside Haven, then close it.
cases.emptyBody: Cases sent to your organisation appear here.
cases.claimHint: Claim the case so others in your organisation know you are on it.
cases.noteHint: What was done. Up to 1000 characters.
cases.closeConfirmBody: A closed case cannot be reopened or changed.
cases.closedNote: This case is closed. No further actions can be recorded.
cases.cancelledNote: This case was cancelled by an operator. No further actions can be recorded.
cases.externalNote: External actions are recorded here only. Haven does not contact any service.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subject: Subject
audit.emptyBody: Events are recorded as people use Haven.

access.title: You don't have access to this page
access.resident: This page is for residents. Staff accounts work in the staff workspace.
access.lead: You are signed in as {name}. Sign in with a different account, or go back to your own area.

editor.categoryHint: Not sure? Leave it as Unclassified and we’ll leave it unclassified.
editor.descriptionHint: In your own words. Short is fine. Optional if you add a photo, video or audio.
editor.weapon: There was a weapon or an immediate threat
editor.weaponHint: This marks the report as an emergency. If you are in danger now, call 112.
editor.repeat: This has happened to me before
editor.districtHint: Choose the district, or drop a pin and we’ll fill it in.
editor.districtFromPin: Set from your pin. Remove the pin to choose a district yourself.
editor.placeHint: For example: the tram stop by the Main Market Square.
editor.locationDenied: We couldn’t get your location. You can pick a spot on the map or choose a district instead.
editor.locationOutside: Your location is outside Kraków. Pick a spot on the map or choose a district instead.
editor.gapPlace: A pin or a place description
editor.mapTitle: Pick the place on the map
editor.mapHint: Move the map so the pin points at the place. Arrow keys move the map; Escape cancels.
editor.evidenceCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# file} other {# files}}
editor.saveFailed: Couldn’t save just now. Your changes are still here; we’ll try again.
editor.conflictBody: It was saved from another tab or device. Reload to see the latest version; copy anything you want to keep first.
editor.fileHint: Filing sends your report to Haven’s team. You can still add details afterwards.
editor.fileBlocked: Complete the “Required to file” list to file this report.
editor.fileIncomplete: Something required is still missing. Check the “Required to file” list.
editor.fileFailed: We couldn’t file the report just now. Your draft is safe; please try again.

evidence.title: Evidence

error.type: This kind of file isn’t supported. Add a photo, video or audio file.
error.failed: The upload didn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.removeBody: {name} will be deleted from your draft. This can’t be undone.
evidence.vaultBody: Files are stored privately with your report. Only you and the Haven response team can open them, and a partner service only once your case is routed to it. Every viewing is logged.
evidence.notScanned: Pilot: uploaded files are not scanned for malware.

routing.title: Routing (simulated)
routing.confirmationHint: Haven’s team will check the details with you before acting.
routing.explain: Haven’s Smart Router picks a responder from fixed, published rules — it is not AI. A person on Haven’s team reviews every report.

escalation.title: Escalate this report
escalation.lead: If the situation is getting worse, you can ask for this report to be treated as more urgent. Escalating needs a verified identity.
escalation.failed: We couldn’t escalate the report just now. Please try again.

messages.title: Messages from Haven
messages.empty: No messages yet. We’ll show them here.

kind.request_information: We need a little more information

messages.cancellationNotice: Thank you for your report. Haven’s team has reviewed it and closed it. No further action is planned.

decision.title: Decision
decision.followReplyBody: This asks the resident for more information. Edit the message before sending.
decision.followPromoteBody: This sends the case to the Neighborhood Volunteer Network (fictional). Edit the reason before confirming.
decision.followReplyPrefill: Thank you for your report. You mentioned a photo, video or recording — could you add it to your report? It helps us find the right support.
decision.followPromotePrefill: Lower-severity harassment; community support is the best fit.
decision.replyHint: The resident sees this text, never your name.
decision.cancelCommentHint: Staff only. The resident gets a neutral closing notice.
decision.cancelConfirmBody: The case closes for good and the resident gets a neutral notice. This can’t be undone.
decision.closedNote: This case is closed. No further decisions can be made.

error.stale: Someone else changed this case while you were looking at it. Reload it to see the latest version.
error.closed: This case has been closed in the meantime.
error.invalid: Check the form and try again.
error.unavailable: The decision wasn’t saved. Try again in a moment.
